from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import colorsys, hashlib, json
import numpy as np
root=Path('.')
assets=sorted((root/'outputs/v1/ecommerce').glob('*.jpg'))+sorted((root/'outputs/v1/social').glob('*.jpg'))
source=np.asarray(Image.open(root/'inputs/01-product_master.png').convert('RGB'))
cut=np.asarray(Image.open(root/'outputs/v1/product-cutout-exact.png').convert('RGBA'))
source_crop=source[170:940,240:840,:]
metrics={
 'asset_count':len(assets),
 'assets':[],
 'cutout_rgb_max_abs_diff_vs_source_crop':int(np.abs(cut[:,:,:3].astype(int)-source_crop.astype(int)).max()),
 'cutout_alpha_nonzero_fraction':float((cut[:,:,3]>0).mean()),
}
for p in assets:
 im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
 arr=np.asarray(im)/255.0
 mx=arr.max(axis=2); mn=arr.min(axis=2); delta=mx-mn
 sat=np.where(mx>0,delta/mx,0)
 # Yellow/gold hue 30-70 degrees, with meaningful saturation.
 hue=np.zeros_like(mx)
 mask=delta>1e-6
 r,g,b=arr[:,:,0],arr[:,:,1],arr[:,:,2]
 idx=mask & (mx==r); hue[idx]=((g[idx]-b[idx])/delta[idx])%6
 idx=mask & (mx==g); hue[idx]=(b[idx]-r[idx])/delta[idx]+2
 idx=mask & (mx==b); hue[idx]=(r[idx]-g[idx])/delta[idx]+4
 hue=hue*60
 gold=((hue>=30)&(hue<=70)&(sat>=0.35)&(mx>=0.35))
 metrics['assets'].append({'path':str(p),'size':list(im.size),'mode':im.mode,'saturated_gold_pixel_fraction':round(float(gold.mean()),8)})
print(json.dumps(metrics,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY"
